title: Microsoft Teams: Report a Security Concern in Meetings
description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and other suspicious behavior. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investigation, remediation, and ongoing improvements to security protections.
